items.title: Host leakage: the installed program directory holds only what runs Naima
Git option injection through `source` in naima.json
`naima init` can lock a commit the source lacks, and may commit a credential token
Launcher permissions break when a project path contains a comma
CI is not reproducible, and runs on Ubuntu only
`naima init` prints a hint naming a plugin type instead of a real command
A relative `source` path in naima.json is accepted
Helper functions are duplicated between the launcher and the CLI

note: host-dist: runtime-only dist branch, plus the review fixes located in program.ts, launcher.ts, init and .github/
